name: mirage
text: Understood: each day's profit/loss, the daily bars and the running-total chart will be taken from Novig's own wallet ledger by day, not from the sum of logged bets. I've logged it (LD2) and will build it together with the ledger-vs-Tracker reconciliation, so the all-time figure and the daily numbers agree. I'll message you when the release is out; nothing has changed in the app yet.
